slug: 2026-02-25 South Africa puts data centres on par with energy, ports in big policy shift

facts.fact: TechCentral states that Google launched its first African cloud region in Johannesburg in 2025.
TechCentral describes Teraco, owned by Digital Realty, as South Africa's largest data centre operator with nearly 190MW of IT load, its Isando campus being the largest at 70MW.

note: Article date used for Teraco as no opening date is given. Azure and AWS facilities mentioned without a stated live region; Vantage campus described as being built.
